title: Move learners to a newer version
intro: Learners stay on the version they started, even after you publish a newer one. Move them here when a newer version fixes or improves something they should get. Nothing changes until you have seen exactly what happens to each learner and confirmed it.
noPermission: Only owners and administrators can move learners. You can still see the versions and past moves.
nothingToMove: No learner is on a version that has a newer published version, so there is nobody to move.
versions.title: Versions
versions.row: Version {version} · {learners, plural, =0 {no learners} one {# learner} other {# learners}}
form.who.cohort: Everyone on version {version} ({count, plural, one {# learner} other {# learners}})
form.previewHint: This only checks. Nobody is moved until you confirm below.
preview.title: What moving to version {to} does
preview.content: Version {to} compared with {from}: {added, plural, =0 {no new lessons} one {# new lesson} other {# new lessons}}, {changed, plural, =0 {no changed lessons} one {# changed lesson} other {# changed lessons}}, {removed, plural, =0 {no removed lessons} one {# removed lesson} other {# removed lessons}}.
preview.totals.waits: Moved when they finish what they are doing
preview.rules: Evidence stays recorded with the version it was earned on. Deadlines, limits and extensions stay as they are; new lessons get the new version's settings. A learner in the middle of a question or activity is moved when they finish it, within {days} days.
learner.kept: {count, plural, =0 {No completed lessons yet.} one {Keeps # completed lesson.} other {Keeps # completed lessons.}}
learner.checkpointsAgain: Must pass the checkpoint again in: {lessons}. Their earlier answers count for the old version only.
learner.onHold: Counts again once those checkpoints are passed: {lessons}.
learner.removed: No longer in the new version: {lessons}.
learner.changedKept: Changed in the new version but stays completed: {lessons}.
learner.more: {lessons} and {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}
learner.evidence: {count, plural, =0 {No evidence yet.} one {# piece of evidence stays recorded with version {from}.} other {# pieces of evidence stay recorded with version {from}.}}
learner.openWork: Open now: {questions, plural, =0 {no questions} one {# question} other {# questions}}, {activities, plural, =0 {no unfinished activities} one {# unfinished activity} other {# unfinished activities}}. Unfinished activity work stays with the old version.
learner.policy: {count, plural, =0 {Deadlines and limits stay as they are.} one {Deadlines and limits stay as they are; # new chapter or lesson gets the new version's settings.} other {Deadlines and limits stay as they are; # new chapters or lessons get the new version's settings.}}
learner.complete: Finished the course on the old version; after the move the course is not finished until the steps above are done.
confirm.title: Confirm the move
confirm.reasonHint: Saved in the audit log with the move.
confirm.acknowledge: I understand that {count, plural, one {# learner} other {# learners}} must redo some progress, as listed above.
confirm.nobody: Nobody in this preview can be moved. Fix the reasons above, then show the preview again.
result.done: {moved, plural, =0 {Nobody was moved yet.} one {# learner moved.} other {# learners moved.}} {waiting, plural, =0 {} one {# waits to finish what they are doing.} other {# wait to finish what they are doing.}} {refused, plural, =0 {} one {# could not be moved.} other {# could not be moved.}}
history.title: Recent moves
history.totals: {moved} moved · {waiting} waiting · {refused} not moved · {undone} undone · {cancelled} cancelled
history.undoAll: {count, plural, one {Move # learner back} other {Move # learners back}}
history.undoReason: Why are you moving them back?
history.undone: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody was moved back.} one {# learner moved back.} other {# learners moved back.}}
history.undoRefused: {count, plural, one {# learner could not be moved back.} other {# learners could not be moved back.}}
history.cancelled: {count, plural, one {# waiting move stopped.} other {# waiting moves stopped.}}
code.MOVE_ENROLLMENT_NOT_ACTIVE: This enrollment is finished, closed or erased. Only active or paused learners can be moved.
code.MOVE_ALREADY_ON_TARGET: This learner is already enrolled in the new version separately. Use that enrollment instead.
code.MOVE_PERSONAL_CHANGES: This learner has personal changes built on the current version, and they cannot move with them. Leave the learner on this version, or revert their personal changes first.
code.MOVE_IN_STUDY: This learner takes part in a research study of the current version. Moving them would change the study; leave them or end their participation first.
code.MOVE_ALREADY_WAITING: Another move of this learner is already waiting. Stop it first, or wait for it to finish.
code.MOVE_POLICY_REFUSED: The new version's settings for its new lessons conflict with this learner's deadlines or limits. Adjust the course policy, then preview again.
code.MOVE_SHORTENS_GRANTS: The move would shorten time this learner was promised. It was not moved.
code.ATTEMPT_IN_PROGRESS: Answering a question right now. Moved once they answer it or the question expires.
code.ACTIVITY_IN_PROGRESS: Working on an activity right now. Moved once they pause for ten minutes or finish it.
code.PLACEMENT_IN_PROGRESS: Taking the placement check. Moved once it ends.
code.SUPERVISOR_WORKING: The AI supervisor is preparing something for this learner. Moved once it finishes.
code.WAIT_EXPIRED: Waited too long for a good moment and was stopped. Preview the move again.
code.IMPACT_CHANGED: The learner's progress changed while waiting, so the move would now cost something different. Preview it again.
code.MOVE_ACTOR_FORBIDDEN: The person who confirmed this move can no longer move learners. Someone who can should preview it again.
code.MOVE_ENROLLMENT_CHANGED: The learner is no longer on the version this move started from.
code.UNDO_NOT_MOVED: This learner was not moved by this move.
code.UNDO_LEARNER_CONTINUED: The learner has already worked on the new version. Moving them back now would lose that work.
code.UNDO_ALREADY_ON_OLD_VERSION: The learner has enrolled in the old version again separately.
code.UNDO_PERSONAL_CHANGES: The learner has personal changes on the new version.
code.UNDO_NOTHING_TO_UNDO: There is nobody left to move back in this move.
code.MOVE_SAME_VERSION: Choose a different version to move to.
code.MOVE_TARGET_NOT_PUBLISHED: Learners can only move to a published version. Publish it first.
code.MOVE_TARGET_NOT_NEWER: Learners can only move forward, to a newer version.
code.MOVE_TARGET_NOT_RUNNABLE: This version cannot run on this installation right now (for example, an extension it needs is missing). Fix that first.
code.MOVE_COHORT_TOO_LARGE: More than 500 learners are on this version. Move them one by one, or ask an operator to move them in parts.
code.MOVE_NOBODY_TO_MOVE: Nobody in this preview can be moved.
code.MOVE_LOST_CREDIT_UNACKNOWLEDGED: Some learners must redo progress. Tick the box to confirm you understand.
code.STALE_PREVIEW: Something changed since the preview (a learner made progress, or the preview expired). Show the preview again.
code.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This move was already confirmed with a different preview.
code.MOVE_NOT_FOUND: This move no longer exists. Refresh the page.
code.MOVE_NOTHING_WAITING: No move is waiting any more.
code.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to move learners.
code.INVALID_REQUEST: Something in the form is missing or not valid. Check it and try again.
code.RELEASE_NOT_FOUND: That version was not found. Refresh the page.
code.ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND: That learner is no longer on this version. Refresh the list.
code.COURSE_NOT_FOUND: This course was not found. Refresh the page.
code.UNAVAILABLE: The server could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
code.unknown: Not completed ({code}). Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
